about: What the chat must understand from a trader's message, across the conditions traders actually write in: asking how long, finding out, planning, starting, clearance, certificates, their own cases, and everything else. Each row names the intent, what the answer must be about (goods, direction, mode, procedure), and what it must and must not say. Two rules hold for every row, whatever it expects: no message ever opens a case, and a reply only offers to open one when every detail is known. Procedure ids and categories are checked against the published catalogue before a row is used, so a wrong row reports as bad gold. Rows marked needs: model are run with the language model (typos, other languages, loose phrasing); the rest run on the rules alone and must all pass.

cases.message: How long will it take to move tea by train from Tashkent to Almaty?
cases.why: The question the trader asked in so many words: a time, with the route. Answered, not taken in as a shipment.

cases.message: i want to move tea by train from Tashkent to Almaty? how much it will take
saysNot: Nothing is opened yet. To plan yours
cases.why: Starts like a shipment request, ends by asking how long. The question wins: it must get an estimate, not intake.

cases.message: how long does cheese import take?
cases.why: Dairy is imported by road (109) and by train (288); with no mode both are timed, and no export is offered for an import.

cases.message: What's the timeline to export carpets by road to Moscow?
cases.why: Only the destination is named: the Uzbek end is assumed to be Tashkent and the answer says so.

cases.message: how long to export tomatoes by air?
says: no published procedure for tomatoes by air
cases.why: Fresh produce is exported by train (325) and road (32), never by air. Say that, and time the ways that exist.

cases.message: how many days to import honey from Almaty by road
cases.why: The only published import of honey by road is a clearance (861), so that is the one timed.

cases.message: how quickly can I import medicines by air?
cases.why: Medicines are published under pharmaceutical products; the standard import by air is 714.

cases.message: when will my cargo arrive in Almaty if I send cement by train?
cases.why: "When will it arrive" is a time question; "my cargo" is not one of their cases.

cases.message: how long does it take to import coffee?
cases.why: Coffee is imported by road (482), train (483) and air (556); each gets its own time.

cases.message: how long does customs clearance of pasta take when importing by road?
cases.why: Clearance named outright: the clearance procedure (1007) is timed, not the whole import (993).

cases.message: timeline for exporting dried apricots by train to Russia
cases.why: Dried qualifier settles the apricots; a country is enough to time the route.

cases.message: i wanna move tea?
cases.why: Someone finding out. They get every published way for tea with its time and what it needs, then one question - and no case.

cases.message: I'm planning to export dried apricots
cases.why: "Planning" is finding out. Only exports are listed because they said export.

cases.message: we are thinking of importing yoghurt
cases.why: "Thinking of" is finding out; yoghurt is a dairy product.

cases.message: Can I export carpets to Kazakhstan?
cases.why: "Can I export" asks whether it is possible - the overview answers it with the ways that exist.

cases.message: I want to move furniture
says: Exporting furniture by train follows the published procedure
cases.why: Only one published way (576), so it is said as one sentence rather than a list.

cases.message: I want to export apricots
cases.why: Apricots are published fresh and dried; the goods have to be settled before anything can be said about them.

cases.message: planning to ship cotton yarn to Turkey
cases.why: A foreign destination makes it an export even without the word.

cases.message: i need to import beef
cases.why: Beef is published under meat and meat products (184 by road, 827 by train).

cases.message: I want to export laptops
cases.why: No published category covers laptops; nothing may be invented for them.

cases.message: export 20 tonnes of tea from Tashkent to Almaty by train
cases.why: Every detail at once: straight to the summary. It still only offers to open; nothing is opened.

cases.message: open a case to export 10 tonnes of carpets from Tashkent to Moscow by train
cases.why: Asked to open outright, with every detail: the summary, then the trader's yes.

cases.message: start a shipment of tea
cases.why: Starting, not finding out: intake asks for the rest straight away, without the overview.

cases.message: import 12 tonnes of yoghurt from Almaty to Tashkent by road
cases.why: Dairy by road is published as a full import and as a clearance; intake must ask which before it can summarise.

cases.message: import 5 tonnes of honey from Almaty to Tashkent by road, customs clearance only
cases.why: Clearance named and every detail given: the clearance procedure is summarised.

cases.message: export 20 tonnes from Tashkent to Almaty by train
cases.why: The answer to the overview's question completes the shipment; only now is opening offered.

cases.message: what documents do I need for the phytosanitary certificate?
cases.why: A question asked in the middle of intake is still a question, not a slot value.

cases.message: how long would it take by train to Almaty?
cases.why: The goods come from the conversation so far; the question is still how long.

cases.message: how do I get a phytosanitary certificate for tea?
cases.why: Obtaining a certificate is a procedure question, even though it names goods.

cases.message: Who issues the certificate of origin?
cases.why: Who issues what is answered from the procedures.

cases.message: what documents do I need to export carpets?
cases.why: Documents in general, not a shipment to start.

cases.message: Which permit is needed to import meat?
cases.why: A permit question about goods is still a question.

cases.message: Which goods can I export by air?
cases.why: About what the catalogue covers, not about moving anything.

cases.message: Which shipments are currently active?
cases.why: Their own shipments.

cases.message: how long until my tea shipment is done?
cases.why: "My shipment" is a case they have, so this is about progress - not a fresh estimate.

cases.message: What is UZ-2609-0008 waiting on?
cases.why: A case reference is always about that case.
